source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Directly measuring the physical size of the client's tumor itself, rather than their overall functional status and daily abilities","B":"Taking the place of any other clinical assessment the provider would otherwise still need to routinely perform during visits","C":"Objectively describe the client's functional status and ability to perform activities of daily living, informing treatment planning and prognosis","D":"Diagnosing the specific underlying type of cancer the client actually has, based on this single functional measure alone"}}
source_row.rationale: ECOG and Karnofsky performance status scales objectively describe a client's functional status and ability to perform activities of daily living, an important factor informing treatment planning (such as tolerance for aggressive therapy) and prognosis in oncology care.
source_row.source_name: ASCO — Performance Status Assessment in Oncology
